title: P0.92: Startup Chat Bridge Priority Contract
description: Ensure the live human-machine chat bridge is created before idle VM prebuild and before heavy metacognitive maintenance, so the app can explain failures immediately after the desktop shortcut opens.
reason: Live proof after P0.91 showed main window visible and old UI-thread stalls removed, but UIBridge/control chat became reachable only around 18s. A human-simulated audit run too early saw bridge unreachable even though the UI was visible.
next_action: Merge P0.92, update the desktop shortcut runtime, launch IABV from the shortcut, and verify startup_timeline has startup_chat_bridge_ready before deferred_metacognition_start and before lazy_vm_prebuild.
resume_hint: bootstrap now schedules _ensure_startup_chat_bridge_ready immediately after _build_deferred_ui_batch_1. This builds only ControlCenterVM/UIBridge early; other lazy VMs stay governed by idle prebuild and resource pressure.
